title: OpenChainGraph receipt envelope (public, language-agnostic)
description: Extracted from the NORMATIVE artifact envelope in OpenChainGraph SPEC.md section 1 and openchain-graph-v0.4.schema.json. This file republishes the receipt shape standalone, with zero dependence on any AINumbers code: a consumer needs only this schema, the vectors in ../vectors/, and a standard SHA-256 + JSON implementation to verify conformance. It does not define a new envelope; it is a generalized restatement of an existing normative shape for external, cross-language consumption. Fields not needed to verify a receipt's execution_hash (spec-internal profile extensions such as clause_bindings, private_inputs, anchor_bindings) are omitted here; consult SPEC.md directly for the full internal schema.

@context.description: JSON-LD context URL, or an array of them.

chaingraph_version.description: Envelope version this receipt was minted under, e.g. "0.4.0".

compute_mode.description: Where the computation ran. Excluded from the execution_hash preimage.

mandate_type.description: Free-text classification of what kind of decision this receipt records. Not a closed enum.

execution_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized JSON of exactly { policy_parameters, output_payload } and nothing else. See ../README.md for the canonicalization algorithm and the accompanying vector corpus.

chain.description: Provenance edges to parent receipts in a multi-step chain. Excluded from the execution_hash preimage.

policy_parameters.description: Half of the execution_hash preimage. All decision inputs live here.

output_payload.description: Half of the execution_hash preimage. The computed result.

compliance_flags.description: Free-text labels. Excluded from the execution_hash preimage.

audit_signature.description: Container for optional post-hash attachments: a W3C Data Integrity proof (proof), a kernel-source content digest (build_identity), and/or a zkVM compute-integrity receipt (compute_proof). None of these members can alter execution_hash by construction — they are attached after hashing.

sha256ref.description: A bare 64-hex-char SHA-256 digest, or the same digest with a "sha256:" prefix.

dataIntegrityProof.description: A W3C Data Integrity proof (cryptosuite eddsa-jcs-2022) over the receipt minus this proof member. OPTIONAL.

verificationMethod.description: A did:key resolving to the signing Ed25519 public key.

previousProof.description: For an endorsement (countersignature): the id(s) of the proof(s) this one endorses.

proofSetOrChain.description: A single proof, or an array (parallel proof set and/or endorsement chain).

buildIdentity.description: Content digest of the exact kernel source that produced this receipt. Advisory publication, not a proof of execution.

buildType.description: Algorithm URI that produced the digest.

source_ref.description: Optional dereferenceable URL or commit pinning the source.

computeProof.description: A zkVM receipt proving a named guest program produced output_payload, verifiable without re-execution.

system.description: zkVM identifier, e.g. risc0, sp1, jolt.

journal.description: Public outputs committed by the guest program.
